purpose: Exhaust every rule-complete retained anytime-goalscorer implication into the same match's Over 0.5 market before viewing any cross-family package price.

distinctness.prior_soccer_graphs: The prior retained soccer graphs exhaust exact-score, first-to-score, BTTS, full-total, team-total, match-result, halftime-result, and second-half-result identities; they do not test player-prop markets.
distinctness.this_graph: For every complete player-props plus more-markets family, this graph tests NO anytime goalscorer plus YES Over 0.5, which pays at least one pUSD because a credited player goal makes the match total positive and both legs resolve 50-50 on full cancellation.
distinctness.price_blind_freeze: Event and rule metadata were inspected to define the family. No goalscorer-to-total price sum was inspected before this contract was frozen.

retained_source.population_scope: Every complete player-props plus more-markets soccer family in the immutable 100-event response.

relation_contract.legs: NO anytime goalscorer plus YES full-game Over 0.5
relation_contract.required_common_horizon: first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time
relation_contract.required_player_rule: YES only when the named player is credited with a goal; inactive or did-not-play resolves NO; full cancellation resolves 50-50
relation_contract.required_total_rule: Over only when the teams combine for at least one goal; full cancellation resolves 50-50

price_contract.missing_side_specific_price: fail closed and do not substitute outcomePrices

stopping_rules.zero_strict_candidates: Terminalize this retained population without any venue request.
stopping_rules.one_or_more_strict_candidates: Retain all strict rows and rank deterministically. Because every retained match has ended, make no request; preregister one future distinct active equivalent relation before any exact book access.
